entries.title: Lamborghini Huracán STO Rental Miami – $1,495/Day | Lussaro

entries.title: Porsche 911 Turbo S Cabriolet Specs | Lussaro Collection

entries.note: fleet.js calls it "911 Turbo S Cabriolet". Retargeted 26 Nov 2026. 'porsche rental miami' and the H1 'Porsche 911 Turbo S Rental Miami' belong to /porsche-911-turbo-s-rental-miami. This page is the spec, photo and booking record, the same split as the Urus and the Mercedes-Benz S580.

entries.title: Lamborghini Urus Specs, Photos & Rates | Lussaro Collection
entries.description: Lamborghini Urus we rent in Miami: 641 hp, 3.3s to 60, $995 a day or $845 a day for 3 days or more. 100 miles included. Photos, specs, and a 3D model.
entries.note: "Lamborghini Urus Rental Miami" belongs to /lamborghini-urus-rental-miami (the ad funnel). The generated title duplicated it exactly, so the two pages competed. This page takes the model-detail angle instead. Changed 22 Nov 2026 from the SEO audit.

entries.title: Mercedes-AMG G63 Rental Miami | Lussaro Collection

entries.title: Mercedes-Maybach GLS 600 Specs & Rates | Lussaro Collection
